title: VV Designer sketch export (vv-fbx-sketch)
description: A sketch for the IWMAC VV Designer (vv_fbx.qxs), as accepted by the Logic Designer Import/Export userscript. Either the envelope form or the bare sketch document. NOTE: this schema catches structural mistakes; run validate-vv-sketch.js for the full semantic ruleset (valid block types, per-type data payloads, single-wire inputs).

generator.description: v1.4+: userscript version that exported the file (e.g. "LDIO v1.4.0"). Optional, additive.

requires_processes.description: v1.4+: library processes the sketch depends on — the target plant's library must publish these keys. Optional, additive; only stamped when process blocks are used.

id.description: Numeric block id, unique within the sketch. NEVER a string.

type.description: UPPERCASE palette key (e.g. PARAMV, CONST, BIGGERTHAN, ALARM) or a published process key. EQUAL and WRITEOUTUNIT do not exist — use LIKE and WRITETOUNIT. v17 (full-fleet census, 145911 blocks): for process blocks, block.type is always the ASCII-uppercase of block.func — type === func.replace(/[a-z]/g, c => c.toUpperCase()) holds on 13247/13247 process blocks. So a process type is never lowercase-hex; the lowercase-hex form (22_603a95656b7e48.25839159) is the FUNC of the same block. No two process types differ only by case (468 distinct → 468 case-folded), so compare process type EXACTLY and process func case-insensitively. Non-ASCII letters (only å U+00E5 and ø U+00F8 occur) survive that uppercasing because [a-z] does not match them — hence PW_..._STåR_I_AUTO. Never pattern-match a process key beyond this.

func.description: The block_func for this type — copy verbatim from the reference table (e.g. paramv, const, biggerthan, alarm).

data.description: Per-type config payload (snake_case host fields: driver_ids[], initial_value, pri, alarm_type, …) or null to import unconfigured.

override.description: Display overrides, e.g. {"alias_text": "My label"}. This is where the on-canvas label lives.

group.description: Ad-hoc grouping tag stamped by the host on some blocks. String OR number ("0", 0, "process" all occur). Unrelated to the sketch-level groups[] array. Preserve on round-trip; never require.

required_plant_revision.description: Per-block twin of the sketch-level require_plant_revision, mostly on the rev-620 family (IF, AVG_IN_PERIOD, WEATHER, CALENDAR_2_0, CRITERIA). Preserve on round-trip; never require.

current_revision.description: Process instances only — the library revision the instance was stamped at. Present on ~82% of process blocks; readers tolerate its absence.

x.description: Canvas x. Negative values are production-real (a live CALENDAR sits at x=-40); generators should still keep everything >= 0.

y.description: Canvas y. Negative values are accepted by the host — do not reject them on import.

id.description: Block id (integer, must exist in blocks[]).

put.description: 0-based pin index. Named pins (out/a/b/trigger) do not exist.
